pages.text: If an entity enters a block focus influenced by a time hallow, it will become "paused" - arrows will freeze midair, TNT will stop counting down, mobs will stop moving, and so on. Keeping an entity paused consumes one time spirit per second.

As mentioned in Essentials, random ticks can be turned into time spirits. If a block influence of a time hallow would be randomly ticked, it will yield nine time spirits (so long as the time hallow has room) and will not be ticked.
